layout: header: magic(4) uint32 block_count, uint32 vertex_count, uint32 line_count; then blocks (4-byte aligned): int32[2*vertex_count] [lon*scale, lat*scale] pairs, uint32[line_count] vertices per line, uint8[line_count] min_zoom*10 (255 = absent), zero padding to 4 bytes

cell_grid.split_rule: a line is cut where it enters a new cell; the first piece ends at the first vertex inside the new cell, the next piece starts there; no vertex is created, no segment is duplicated; bbox is measured from real vertices

source.note: Converted from the in-repo 110m asset (Natural Earth master branch, 2-decimal rounding); not re-derived from v5.1.2. Precision stays 0.01 deg.

boundary_corrections.note: the only borders line lying wholly inside the Perekop box; every vertex of the 10m Natural Earth Perekop line is within 0.047 deg of it. No other byte of the file changed.

dropped.country_pair_basis: no pair fields in this file; same NE id as the 10m record
dropped.note: Perekop kıstağı 'Disputed (please verify)' Rusya-Ukrayna çizgisi; Türkiye'nin resmî görüşü: Kırım Ukrayna'dır. NE'nin kendi Türkiye bakışında da bu kayıt 'Admin-1 boundary' (FCLASS_TR); 50m kaydında ülke çifti alanı yok, çift aynı NE kimliğinin 10m kaydından
